terms.p: A function defined in an impl block that takes no self parameter, so it is called through the type rather than through a value, as in Config::new.
The self parameter of a method. Its form (&self, &mut self or self) decides whether calling the method reads the value, writes to it, or consumes it.
Writing ..other at the end of a struct literal to take every field you did not list from another value of the same type, moving each one that is not Copy.
